structured_output.analysis: The best recipe, iso_3.15 (record E514ab09c524e), uses 3.147953869047619 of the 3.1484375-bit budget, so a precision upgrade has to be paid for with a downgrade elsewhere. The evidence gives no measured cost for moving any int3 layer down to int2, so a funded swap would be a guess. The four refused proposals from last round failed only because their rationales quoted a rounded KL value. I am resubmitting the same changes to GPTQ options, which do not change stored bits, and the rationales now quote only exact numbers from cited records. The loss is concentrated in the MLP layers. For example, layer 14 down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 has KL 0.00633466 (E4c3f9b73e065), and layer 27 up_proj with gptq_int3 has KL 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded). Better GPTQ error compensation should help all GPTQ-family layers, and those make up most of the grid.

proposals.name: opt_act_order
proposals.rationale: Turns on act_order=true for every GPTQ-family method and keeps the bits the same. The layers where loss concentrates have heavy-tailed activations: layer 27 up_proj has activation kurtosis 1090.09 (E24beed188b6a), and its gptq_int3 KL is 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded). Act-order quantizes the high-Hessian columns first. Base recipe: E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: opt_damp_low
proposals.rationale: Lowers damp to 0.005 for all GPTQ-family methods so the Hessian compensation is less regularized, with no change in bits. Target layers: layer 14 down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 has KL 0.00633466 (E4c3f9b73e065), and layer 3 up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 has KL 0.0064177 (E6f4f7ea296d5). Base recipe: E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: opt_damp_high
proposals.rationale: Raises damp to 0.05 to make the Hessian inverse more stable against outlier activation channels, with no change in bits. Layer 27 gate_proj has activation channel_absmax_ratio 65.2425 (E919842437de0), and its rht_gptq_int3 KL is 0.00498703 (Efa0bb391da67). Base recipe: E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: opt_act_order_damp_low
proposals.rationale: Combines act_order=true with damp=0.005 for the GPTQ-family layers, with no change in bits. Target layers: layer 2 up_proj with gptq_int3 has KL 0.00641875 (E9baa10763ebe), and layer 1 up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 has KL 0.00611131 (E0564bc6ad1eb). Base recipe: E514ab09c524e.
